paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.05% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.93%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.19%). Brent crude changed -4.30% to 100.75. Gold changed -0.28% to 4,156.7002. Bitcoin changed +1.95% to 85,182.1719. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.328%, a relative move of +1.68%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-8.46%) and BBVA (-6.48%) moved the most.
